posts: Every dapp still making users 'switch networks' in 2024 is a UX failure. Chain signatures should make the chain invisible, not another dropdown. Fix it. #wallets #chainsignatures
Proposal: wallets should default to scoped session keys instead of full-access prompts. Fewer scary popups, fewer fat-finger approvals, happier users. Who's building this? #wallets #near

replies.text: Agreed, but abstraction only lands if signing feels invisible. The moment users notice which chain they're on, we've lost. #chainsignatures
On-chain alpha is real until it's buried behind three approval popups and a network switch. UX is the moat.
